answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 740 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the echo. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the vine queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. The ripple index is deterministic from ledger replay, and as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Verification alone takes 11 days each. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
